manualCases.behavior: Presenter notes, next-slide preview, elapsed timer, keyboard step navigation, and a separate synchronized audience stage with exactly one active media playback surface.
manualCases.expectedResult: Independent CUA reviewer observes these behaviors on isolated candidate server; next-slide media never autoplays and opening audience stage does not duplicate audio.
manualCases.observedResult: Independent Sheets reviewer verified presenter notes and next-slide preview, animation progression on the same slide, current-slide real H264/WAV playback, zero mounted media in Up next, removal of presenter media when opening the separate audience stage, and media removal on exit. The presenter snapshot shows an elapsed timer at 00:06.
limitations: Chrome initially blocked autoplay in the separate audience popup. Its native Play control succeeded; automatic playback success is not claimed for that popup.
The independent report and snapshot establish the visible elapsed timer, but do not claim a separate timer-reset interaction or exhaustive browser keyboard coverage.
This is bounded verification of the isolated local candidate, not whole-application acceptance, original Google runtime observation, or complete feature parity.

referencedEvidence.scope: Static local implementation inspection captured before advanced edits; not an executed Google or baseline-browser workflow.
referencedEvidence.locationNote: Outside benchmark-v2; original evidence path preserved. No packaging requirement is implied.

limits: Public documentation informs feature scope only. No full Google behavior or visual parity is asserted.

PowerPoint uses named placeholder cards for audio/video and initially visible objects for local animation steps; HTML/Commonplace retain playable media and animations. Native tables/charts and embedded chart data are exported.
The model represents master defaults, not a complete inherited Google Theme Builder layout tree.
Model and artifact tests do not establish browser codec compatibility or Microsoft PowerPoint opening fidelity.
